readings.Aries: Not every battle is yours. Choosing which ones to enter is the actual skill. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: Comfort is not the same as safety. The distinction matters today. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Gemini: Something you said lightly is being taken seriously. Check in. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: Something that happened long ago is affecting today in ways you haven't fully mapped. Start mapping. Let this one be easy.
readings.Leo: Your warmth is your superpower. Don't let the performance crowd it out. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Virgo: The thing you're not saying is specific enough to be said. Say it that specifically. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Libra: Your need for balance is not weakness — it's an accurate reading of what makes systems work. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Scorpio: The obsession has given you everything it has to give. Release it. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Sagittarius: The enthusiasm you've withdrawn from a project was the project's primary fuel source. Restore some. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Capricorn: You are more resilient than the people around you know, because you don't show the load. Show some of the load. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Aquarius: Your need for intellectual stimulation is as real as any physical need. Feed it properly today. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Pisces: There is a vision you've had repeatedly that is trying to become real. Give it some of your practical attention. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
